messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — PR #8342 is red in CI. Pre-commit/typecheck and rustfmt both failed on the same run. Anyone who can take a quick look?

CI Bot: Build failed on commit 7c9ab2d — jobs: pre-commit (typecheck), format-check. Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/gh/8342/checks/12345

Julian Kim: On it. Can you paste the pyright/typecheck error? pyright failures are usually either a stub bump or an accidental Any->Optional change.

Maya Patel: Pasting the failing snippet from the typecheck job:```
src/kvcache/cache.py:42: error: Argument of type "Optional[Dict[str, Any]]" cannot be assigned to parameter "state: Dict[str, Any]" of function "restore"
  --> src/kvcache/cache.py:42
42 |     restore(state)
     ~~~~~~~~~^^^^^
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 112 source files)
```Also rustfmt failure:```
rustfmt error: file contains trailing comma causing fmt to fail at src/serving/kernel.rs:120
```

Alex Rivera: Hmm, that type is odd — looks like `restore` now expects non-optional state. Did someone change a signature in a recent commit? Which files changed in this PR vs main?

Maya Patel: The PR only touches kvcache annotations and a tiny test. I did update `restore` usage in a follow-up patch but didn't change signature. Suspect a stub or mypy/pyright pinned version drift on the CI image.

Julian Kim: Could be. Two quick things: 1) rerun the `typecheck` job on the same commit to see if it's flaky, 2) if it persists, bisect between main@7c85f... and main@7c9ab2d to find the offending commit. I can trigger a bisect if you want.

Maya Patel: Please trigger bisect, thanks. If it's a toolchain bump we should see many failures across PRs.

Ruth Lang: FYI I saw a rustfmt upgrade land yesterday in infra (CI image). That would explain the rustfmt bit; we might just need to run `cargo fmt --all` or pin the rustfmt version.

CI Bot: Rerun requested by Julian Kim. Typecheck job rerun started (job id 12346).

CI Bot: Rerun finished — typecheck passed on rerun. Format-check still failing.

Julian Kim: Okay typecheck passed when re-run -> likely a transient environment flake or caching issue. For rustfmt: Ruth, can you confirm exact rustfmt version in the new image? If it's bumped, we should either add a CI shim or update repo fmt.

Ruth Lang: Confirmed: rustfmt 1.6.0 in new image vs 1.5.0 previously. I'll open infra PR to pin to 1.5.0 and also create a tiny formatting-only PR to keep CI green.

Alex Rivera: In the meantime, Maya — if you want to keep momentum, rebase onto latest main and run `cargo fmt` locally, push a formatting commit. That should fix the format-check quickly.

Maya Patel: Will do the local fmt commit now and push. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Julian Kim: Thanks — since typecheck was flaky on first run, I'll follow up with a quick health check on the pyright image caching. If we see more flakes I'll open a dedicated ticket.

Maya Patel: Pushed formatting commit and reran CI. Looks green now. Merging after a quick post-merge check.

Ruth Lang: Filed infra pin PR and noted the rustfmt bump in the changelog.

Maya Patel: Great — closing the loop. Appreciate the quick responses everyone.
